translations.web: Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the assemblies.
translations.bsb: Regardless, each one should lead the life that the Lord has assigned to him and to which God has called him. This is what I prescribe in all the churches.
translations.kjv: But as God hath distributed to every man, as the Lord hath called every one, so let him walk. And so ordain I in all churches.
translations.asv: Only, as the Lord hath distributed to each man, as God hath called each, so let him walk. And so ordain I in all the churches.
